dialogue.line: Boyd, are you seriously okay with him taking magic mushrooms
that he found in a haunted forest?
If there are answers in his head,
we need to get them out. Okay are you ready for this?
It's a giant made of clay.
It protects people. It's a champion.
That thing I carried inside me, I still feel it.
He feels how afraid I am.
But making this, it makes me feel strong.
I thought his yellow suit was funny.
He came in a car, just like the rest of us.
When I found Mom out by the bottle tree, I saw him.
I can't imagine what this is like for her.
This could actually be an instruction manual
on how to save my Dad.
I need to find the Lake of Tears.
My Dad told me it's here.
{\an8}Maybe once I find it, it can make him better.
I'm telling you, those are bodies.
Something floats up from the bottom of Nightmare Lake
and the first thing you wanna do is drag it ashore?
back at Colony House, but we all get a say here.
Look, we have to sleep here tonight.
Even if we took off running right now,
we'd never make it back to town before dark.
I don't know about you, but I would feel a whole lot better
just floated to the surface of this lake.
I'm sorry we couldn't save you.
I really wanted it to be the Lake of Tears.
I think the mushrooms kicked in.
It's a little more direct than I expected.
Jade! Jade! Whoa! Whoa! Whoa! Hey!
This may not have been such a great idea.
Hey, maybe we just-- maybe we go see Kristi and we just--
I have to do this. I have to do this.
I need you to be my anchor, my guide.
You need to tell me what's real and, you know, what isn't.
And we need a safe word, something that you can say
if things start to, you know, go off the rails;
All right, where do we start?
You just take nice deep breaths, okay?
May-- Maybe we don't have to do this. I mean...
maybe we should wait. It doesn't--
it really doesn't hurt nearly as much as it did.
I know you're scared, but if we don't reset this bone,
and then, we're gonna have much bigger problems
than we can handle here, okay?
Okay. We'll go on the count of three.
And I need you to take a nice, big deep breath in.
Sorry. I know that was the worst part.
I just thought it'd be better if we did it quick.
No, it's in the ambulance. I'll be right back.
{\an8}♪ Now I have children of my own ♪
Making sure there's no more surprises.
Why would someone put those in the lake?
There's only one reason I can think of
that people put life-sized dolls full of stuffing outside.
You put them in the field to scare the birds away.
What if the reason these were in the lake
is to keep something else down there...
What? Do we just walk around the forest all day,
waiting for the trees to start talking?
I haven't asked the question! We need to ask...
Show me what I used to know...
Show me what's in here that'll help us leave.
What's wrong? What do you see?
It's me when I was 12 years-old.
It's the day my grandmother died.
She asked me to play for her, so I-I did.
she just wasn't in the room anymore.
But I couldn't look at her; I just kept playing,
'cause I knew, the moment I stopped,
So, I just played and played and played.
Goddammit, this isn't what I asked for!
I wanna remember why we're stuck here!
I wanna remember how to get home!
I just wanna go back! I wanna go back!
Where did he go? He was-- huh?
Some asshole I saw nailed to a tree out at the settlement
wants me to drink the same skull of blood he's been
schlepping around with him since we met!
Hey, maybe he's trying to tell you how to get your answers.
Hey, whoa, whoa, whoa. Hey! What's-- what's-- Jade!
I'm starting to see the shape now.
I wanted to say I'm sorry.
Earlier, I should have tried to...
We're strongest when we back each other up,
and I was not doing that.
and I should've, uh, backed you up.
You said you were still connected to that thing.
in a way I can't really explain.
knowing that, one of these nights,
I'm gonna see him standing there...
Listen, if you need, um-- if you need anything...
I keep a little stash on hand, you know,
just to take the edge off.
Uh, I'm fine. Yeah, I just needed a minute.
Just, once in a while, I...
stop and think about the types of things
that have become normal for us.
I mean, we're sitting here, packing life-sized dolls
full of rocks because we think that they're gonna...
Take my advice: stop thinking about it.
Think about getting back to your wife.
We need to get these fuckers back in the water.
Do you really think there's something bad in the water?
I think I'd rather not find out.
Tabitha, uh, can you help me with something?
Okay, I saw that look on your face.
I don't know, it was familiar.
I think I've seen them before.
I'm trying, Donna! I'm try-- I'm trying.
All I see are, like, little pieces and their faces and...
Is there something in that lake that we need to be afraid of?
We're ready to drag 'em back in.
Hey... Hey, what does that mean?
That I'm gonna see things that I don't wanna see, huh?
Don't fucking leave me like that.
I've been here the whole time.
If this is too much, we can still go back.
The answers you sought come wrapped in painful truths.
I-I don't think you should look at that anymore.
What-- What-- What do you do here...
Well, there's so much time just sitting around,
worrying if you're gonna survive the night.
You-- You have to live, son.
No, I'm fine. I'm okay. Just, just...
Cards. To-- to play. You got cards?
Maybe you should go lie down.
Lie down? I don't wanna lie down! I wanna...
You remember when we used to play?!
We used to sit at the piano and you would--
I'd give you a note. That was your note.
And you-- you were so little!
she had such a beautiful voice. You remember?
oh, come on! We-- We'd sit there and we'd talk about
how we'd all go 'round the world someday
and see all the beautiful things and we'd be...
Who the fuck are you to tell me?
Do you know what he did?
What he did to my wife?
I'm sorry. I didn't mean-- I'm...
No. No, you-- you-- you don't know--
you don't know what he did.
Show him the picture of what he did.
You telling me you didn't bring the marshmallows?
'Cause I don't want Julie to be alone.
first thing in the morning, we're gonna get up,
grab our packs, and get the heck outta here. Okay?
I like it when you're here.
It's just not as scary when you're around.
The one time you tried doing something
that would have actually proved it was real, it didn't work!
This isn't about me or the bookmark.
'Kay? This is about you and you being scared of those ruins.
And you're a stubborn little child
who doesn't know what the fuck's in front of her face.
Really? And what is that, huh?
Oh, this place is fucking with your head
because it knows how much you miss your dad!
I watched you have two seizures in two days.
All right? You're literally frying your own brain.
So, why don't you tell me what's more likely:
that you're traveling through chapters of a story
or that one of these days, you're gonna have a seizure
That is a risk I am willing to take!
And if your dad was here right now he'd be fucking stunned
at how goddamn stupid you are.
You're only angry at me right now because you know I'm right.
Okay, I was having a moment, that's all!
That was way more than just a moment, Marielle!
Okay, so, this place has never gotten to you before?
You haven't just need a minute to freak the fuck out?
It is not a big deal.
Just give it a rest, Kristi!
It's the people from my hallucinations.
Why were they playing that song?
These were the lives that I lived here.
Some of them... and many more.
Look at them closely. What do you see?
None of them are ripped apart.
They weren't killed by the-- by the creatures in the woods!
They were murdered by the people in town.
What? Jade, who are you talking--
Once they learn the truth about who you are,
that it was you that the children were calling for,
Are you saying there's no way home?
How do I stop it from happening this time?
Okay, let's back him up this way.
Are you gonna be all right, Victor?
Yeah. I'll take care of him.
The man in the yellow suit...
But I never should have told him.
Where the hell did he go?
Hey, can we just take a minute here?
Why the fuck were you talking about
What are we doing? Why are we down here?
Give me a hand! Come on!
do you see a door in that wall?
Can you try to tell us what happened in the ambulance?
Every single person who's ever died here.
That's what it was like for me when we were in the chamber.
All I could hear, all I could feel was...
the suffering of every single person who has ever died here.
I kept telling myself it wasn't real,
But when the radio came on, it was like all that pain
and horror just shot through me again.
Maybe God has chosen you to hear their suffering.
I've seen this happen here before.
This place, it gets in people's heads and--
And it's feeding off our suffering and it doesn't stop.
Even after we die, we are still trapped here.
And we never get to leave.
Sometimes, I forget he's just a kid.
He's always seemed so grown up.
Jim used to call him the little professor.
So, curious and full of questions.
Maybe he can figure out what's in the goddamn lake.
Five minutes less than the last time someone asked.
Just try to get some sleep.
All we have to do is hold on until the morning.
Then, we can get the hell outta here
and back to the nightmare we understand.
We've got a long walk in the morning, so--
They were mine. I was playing with them.
He came and took them from me.
He said they gave him nightmares,
so he threw them in the lake.
But one day, the man died,
his nightmares came out of the lake.
Oh, my God, Donna, we have to go.
We have to go right now.
Donna! No, you don't understand! You don't understand!
We're not safe here! We can't stay here.
No, we have a talisman on the door.
No, no, no, talismen won't protect us, not from this!
How do you know that? How the fuck do you know any of that?!
No matter what happens, we have to keep--
I remembered how to hurt them.
But this isn't real! This can't be real!
You asked me to be your anchor, so fucking listen to me.
No, Boyd. We're just in Colony House.
We've been walking down that creepy hallway for--
I will drag you outta here if I fucking have to!
This is where the children were sacrificed.
How does knowing that get us home?
Tabitha and I, we already tried to save them.
Is it-- is it-- is there something here?
Is there something, something we need?
Tell me how we save them when we've already failed!
You should have listened to Boyd.
But you were never really the smart one, were you?
No! No! No, no, no, no!
Get the fuck off of me!
Jade! Jade! Hey, hey, hey! Oh!
What the fuck are we doing here?
How the fuck did we get here?!
No, no, no. We were in the tunnels.
No, you've been sitting here for hours.
I know what we have to do to go home.
I know how we can save the children.
